content.value_statement: Contact searches, bulk imports, and deletions can expose private data or modify the wrong records. This skill applies scoped lookups, minimal disclosure, and confirmation gates.
actual_capabilities: Searches and pages through Sent contacts with narrow filters.
Retrieves one contact by an exact identifier.
Reviews a contact messaging summary without treating it as consent evidence.
Validates and deduplicates proposed records before bulk creation.
Previews bulk creation payloads and requires explicit confirmation.
Fetches, previews, and confirms an exact contact before deletion.
limitations: Requires an authenticated Sent MCP connection using client-managed OAuth.
Cannot change the active organization or Sender Profile without client reauthorization.
Messaging summaries do not prove consent or current reachability.
Does not automatically retry ambiguous create or delete operations.

use_cases.title: Find a customer contact
use_cases.description: Search a narrow contact set and retrieve the exact record needed for support.

use_cases.title: Prepare a contact import
use_cases.description: Validate, deduplicate, preview, and confirm a controlled batch before creation.

use_cases.title: Remove an obsolete contact
use_cases.description: Resolve, fetch, preview, and confirm one exact record before deletion.

prompt_templates.title: Search contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Sent contacts matching [name or phone fragment]. Return only identifiers, labels, and masked phone numbers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for a small, relevant contact set.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve contact [contact ID] and summarize only the fields needed for [task]. Include its messaging summary without inferring consent.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of an exact contact.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a bulk import
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate and deduplicate these contacts: [records]. Preview the exact batch, scope, duplicate handling, and masked targets before asking for confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled creation of multiple contact records.

prompt_templates.title: Verify and delete a contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve contact [identifier], fetch the exact record, and show a destructive-action preview. Ask for explicit confirmation immediately before deletion.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced destructive workflow with target and scope verification.

output: Preview: 23 unique records and 2 duplicates removed.

No contacts have been created. Confirm this exact batch to continue.

output_examples.output: Delete preview: ct_104, Priya S., phone ending in 0182. This action is destructive. Confirm deletion of this exact contact.

best_practices: Use the narrowest filter and return only fields required for the task.
Verify the active organization and Sender Profile before every mutation.
Require a fresh preview and explicit confirmation for each create, delete, or retry.
anti_patterns: Do not expose tokens, credentials, authorization headers, or unnecessary contact data.
Do not treat messaging history or number presence as proof of consent.
Do not delete from guessed identifiers, broad filters, or stale results.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Sent account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an authorized Sent MCP connection using client-managed OAuth 2.1 and PKCE.

faq.question: Can it search my entire contact book?
faq.answer: It can page through contacts, but it should use narrow filters and avoid unnecessary full exports.

faq.question: Can it create many contacts at once?
faq.answer: Yes. It validates, deduplicates, previews, and requests explicit confirmation before creating the exact batch.

faq.question: Can it delete contacts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It must fetch the exact contact, show a deletion preview, and receive fresh explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Does a messaging summary prove consent?
faq.answer: No. Messaging history and number presence do not establish consent or current reachability.

faq.question: What happens when a mutation result is unclear?
faq.answer: The skill reports uncertainty, avoids automatic retries, and rechecks the target before requesting another confirmation.
